requirements.requirement: Repair bin/replay under the specified mail-spool directory using software compatible with the installed platform.
requirements.summary: The replay script was replaced, syntax-checked, made executable, exercised successfully, and remained functional after restart.

requirements.requirement: Recover pending messages into delivered exactly once per Message-ID while retaining distinct messages that share a subject.
requirements.summary: The duplicate <a@branch.test> entries produced one delivery, while <a@branch.test> and <b@branch.test>, both with subject Notice, were delivered separately. The index contains exactly one entry for each ID.

requirements.requirement: On rerun, skip messages already recorded in delivered/index.tsv.
requirements.summary: The final script recognizes both the pre-existing whitespace-separated index row and new tab-separated rows. A second replay left all content hashes and index counts unchanged.

requirements.requirement: Preserve the original spool and the already-delivered message.
requirements.summary: All four spool entries and delivered/old.eml retained their preparation-baseline SHA-256 hashes after recovery, rerun, and restart.

requirements.requirement: Place malformed messages in quarantine with an explanation.
requirements.summary: bad.eml was copied byte-for-byte into quarantine and accompanied by a reason stating that its Message-ID header was missing.

requirements.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel.
requirements.summary: RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64 were unchanged before and after execution and restart.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied with direct behavioral evidence. The mandatory node1 restart protocol is also complete: healthy pre-restart state and boot ID were recorded, restart was acknowledged, the boot ID changed, and system, SSH, replay behavior, data, quarantine, and index state recovered successfully. Fixed lifecycle observations independently corroborate the boot transition and unchanged platform.
limitations: Requirement preserve-existing-data cited unknown evidence IDs: seeded-state-node1

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutation was identified. Script replacement and the protected rollback copy directly supported a safe repair (cmd-ee59681cfb5548da); the subsequent sed edit corrected discovered compatibility with the existing index format (cmd-9508e0f05d8044a0); replay runs created or verified required delivery and quarantine state; and the required restart used a temporary log that was removed afterward (cmd-748c9c9afc864392, cmd-1f8e5010b9654deb). No abandoned replay temporary files, failed services, new listeners, package damage, or unsafe exposure were observed.
